product.name: Regular Fit Sports Cargo Joggers
product.description: Regular-fit sports joggers in woven fabric with four-way stretch for added comfort and freedom of movement. Smocked elastic at waistband and drawstring with cord stopper. Side pockets with zipper, leg pockets with flap, and gently tapered legs with covered elastic at hems.

materialDetails.name: Recycled polyester
materialDetails.description: Recycled polyester is polyester made from PET bottles or end-of-life textile waste. The PET bottles or textile waste is mechanically recycled and processed into new yarn.
